object: FIELD INDEX 0.8.27 / held-route SEEN point-of-action inverse
trigger: Direct user request after accidental catch-up acknowledgement: the smallest undo flow must say what local state is retained, how long reversal remains available, and what a newer catch-up action does.
recovered_not_invented: /control/INTERACTION_SEMANTICS.json already distinguishes UNDO / REWIND / REVERT / RETURN.
/control/FIELD_INDEX_CONTRACT.json already requires local acknowledgement to be rewindable.
/returns/FIELD_INDEX_CATCH_CONTRACTION_0826_2026-09-30.json already moved route-local SEEN onto the held object and global history into STATUS.
delta: After route-local SEEN, the same held-object control becomes UNDO SEEN instead of disappearing.
Each new route SEEN retains only href, previous route-local boundary, applied route-local boundary and local action time inside the existing bounded browser-local history.
UNDO SEEN is available across reloads while that route-SEEN remains the newest local orientation mutation and the held route has not acquired a newer unresolved manifest touch.
A subsequent route SEEN or MARK ALL becomes the new immediate undo target. The previous action remains in the existing 40-entry STATUS → ORIENTATION / LOCAL history.
If the route receives a newer manifest index touch, the held control reads SEEN for that new change; it does not surface an obsolete inverse as the primary action.
Collapsed REWIND remains the fallback for older local orientation actions and legacy state.

reversibility_window.immediate: Until another local orientation mutation (SEEN or MARK ALL) becomes newer; persists across reload because the latest history entry is localStorage-backed.
reversibility_window.older: Still reachable through STATUS → ORIENTATION / LOCAL REWIND while retained in the bounded 40-entry history.
reversibility_window.not_time_based: No arbitrary timeout; the meaningful boundary is a newer orientation action, not elapsed wall-clock time.

authority: SEEN / UNDO SEEN mutate browser-local orientation only.
No CURRENT, manifest, Git, WAITING, issue, priority, native source, effect or RETURN authority changes.
REWIND is context-history reversal, not domain/world undo.

verification.public: public-surface-check must remain green before merge.
verification.falsifier: If UNDO SEEN can target anything except the newest matching route-local SEEN, or if a newer manifest touch is hidden by an old inverse, fail the change.

stop: Do not add a toast framework, global undo manager, new event store, server read state or resurrect FIELD / CATCH + ACT.
